fail.summary: Publish one SPF record at the root of your domain that lists every service that sends your email, and ends in -all (or ~all while testing).

microsoft365: Sign in to wherever your DNS is managed (your domain registrar or web host, not the Microsoft admin centre).
Add or edit the single TXT record at the root (shown as @ or your domain name).
If other services also send as your domain (newsletters, invoicing), add their include: entries before -all, inside the same record.
google: Sign in to wherever your DNS is managed (your domain registrar or web host).
Add or edit the single TXT record at the root (@).
Once you are sure every sender is listed, change ~all to -all.
If other services send as your domain, add their include: entries inside the same record.
cpanel: In cPanel, open Email Deliverability and click Manage next to your domain.
cPanel shows a suggested SPF record. If it reports a problem, use the Repair or Install the suggested record button.
If you also use Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, add their include: entry to the same record. Never create a second SPF record.
You can also edit the TXT record in Zone Editor.

warn.summary: The record works but could be tighter or is close to a limit.

generic: Replace ~all with -all once every legitimate sender is listed.
Remove 'ptr' rules and services you no longer use.
If you are at the 10 lookup limit, replace some include: entries with ip4: or ip6: addresses for senders that never change.
